preconditions: Two independent test runs (distinct environments and CI run IDs) with recorded artifacts and all regression/integrity/rollback gates passed
Verified backup and restore drill against preserved data
Out-of-process recovery controller: Guardian process cannot roll back its own crashed container
Explicit test contracts for old and new behavior; compare A=unmodified control and B=patched candidate or two independent implementation variants
Aggregate success estimate uses minimum of Wilson 95% lower confidence bounds for both independent environments; untested factors force blocked
RBAC and signed immutable change request; local time independent decision log
applySequence: Record pre-change version, config schema, impacted modules and deterministic regression evidence
Stage candidate side by side; never rewrite production in place
Apply only allowlisted reversible change or obtain explicit approval
Restart isolated target service only after external supervisor is armed (not whole HA OS)
Verify /ready, route contracts, database quick_check, portal accessibility, rollback command path, performance window
On failure signal the independent controller to restore exact prior version and configuration snapshot, check data hash and re-run old behavior tests
If rollback fails: isolate and escalate, never loop indefinitely; rate limit retry to one supervised attempt per unique candidate
audit: Record immutable proposal ID, evidence hashes, CI run IDs, before/after version, actions, timestamps, actor, results and any rollback
limits: No automatic fixes or restarts wired in current branch
The word percentage means lower confidence bound from observed outcomes, not LLM probability or guarantee.
No credential exfiltration; private document bytes never enter AI prompts.
No operation without verified isolated restore controller.
